stories.title: Flintshire alcohol-specific death rate among lowest in Wales, ONS data shows
stories.summary: Flintshire has the fourth-lowest alcohol-specific death rate of any local authority in Wales, according to new figures from the Office for National Statistics published today. stories.title: Wales selection and Borders League podium for Deestriders RC
stories.summary: Deestriders runner Angela Deeley has represented Wales at the Masters International match against England, held at the Bideford 10k. stories.title: Flintshire speed cameras issued more than 20,000 fines in 2025
stories.summary: Eight of the ten busiest speed cameras in North Wales are sited in Flintshire, with a single camera on the A5104 at Pontybodkin issuing more than 4,300 fixed penalty notices to drivers in 2025.
